senses.gloss:
उज्जन् उज्-जन् (उद्-जन्), cl. 3. P. -जजन्ति,
-जनितुम्, to beget, produce; cl. 4. A. -जायते, to
be born, originate.
उज्जयन उज्-जयन, &c. See s. v. उज्-जि below.

उज्-जयन, अस्, m., N. of a man; (ई), f. Ujjayinī
or Oujein, the Gr. Οζήνη a city so called in Avanti
(Mālava), formerly the capital of Vikramāditya; it
is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindūs, and
the first meridian of their geographers, from which
they calculate longitude; the modern Oujein is about
a mile south of the ancient city.

उज्जस् उज्-जस् (उद्-जस्), Caus. -जासयति, -यि-
तुम्, to destroy, extirpate (with gen.).

उज्जानक उज्जानक, अस्, m., N. of a Tīrtha;
also spelt उज्जालक.

उज्-जयन्त, अस्, m., N. of a mountain in Surāṣṭra
in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range. See
रैवत.
उज्-जयिनी, f. the city Oujein. See उज्-जयनी.
